harness_contract.intent: Prove that a multi-stage insulin delivery pipeline keeps dose bounds and interlock ordering while every atom is verified locally.
artifact_contracts: Generate evidence: result.json and report.md in reports/{scenario}/latest/ plus per-step logs.
medical_device_scale.proof-cert.json is the proof certificate covering every atom of the scale case.
medical_device_scale.trust-surface.json records trusted atoms, FFI boundaries, Z3 solver time, Lean escalation counts, and budget_policy_fingerprint.
medical_device_scale.composability.json records atom-local closure, composition breaks, and modular_verification_inputs.
medical_device_scale.scale-report.json reports composition breaks through verification_status / verification_violations / next_steps.
Gate order: l1_z3 -> l2_agent; each stage must satisfy its expected_exit, expected_patterns, artifacts, and depends_on contract before downstream evidence is trusted.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Prove that a multi-stage insulin delivery pipeline keeps dose bounds and interlock ordering while every atom is verified locally.
success_criteria: correct_code.mm verifies with a proof certificate for every atom.
verify-cert --strict re-checks the certificate against the source.
std/ trusted atom count stays 0 and the case adds no trusted atoms.
Composability measurement records atom-local closure and composition breaks.
intent_fidelity.drift_risk: Low: every obligation is an explicit atom contract and the certificate is re-checked in strict mode against the source.
